title: EUREKA HYBRID04 RANDOM SCENES + SIX PERFORMANCE PARAM PAGES
author: analoglav
description: Based on user-approved MC78 Digitone OS1.44 MUTE working firmware. Isolated MIDI+YES stock MUTE repair unchanged. MIDI+FUNC toggles EUREKA panel navigation without switching stock MIDI mute bank; TRIG/SYN1/SYN2/FLTR/AMP/LFO page keys show 6 dedicated 128x64 parameter pages, pressing current page again returns to 576-frame 16-scene random animation. Encoders A-D manipulate four meaningful video controls per page (scene, note random chance, scene cut settings, speed/reverse/stutter/scrub, loop/note FX, glitch/inversion/x-y move, density/dilation/blink/pulse, rate/depth/target/waveform LFO). Encoder E-H captured only on page to avoid hidden edits. All TRIG keys 1..16 (OS key IDs26..41) pass to stock even while panels open; no stock note/sequencer reassignment. Original MUTE, global/pattern state and FM remain stock. Granular0.5 untouched. Source-only, compile and on-device pad responsiveness not yet verified.
